# Client Says

> Converts a client's meeting time into your team's timezones, and decodes corporate jargon

- Live: https://clientsays.neorgon.com/
- Part of the Neorgon tool suite (free, no signup, runs in your browser): https://neorgon.com/
- Keywords: timezone, jargon, multi-page

## Your settings and your team (Neorgon Workspace)

Settings (in the header, or the `,` key) holds your time zone, working hours, work days, week start, time format and country. They live in one small cookie on neorgon.com (`neo_me`) that every Neorgon planning tool reads; it never holds a name or an email. Your people and teams live in this browser on the Workspace page, https://neorgon.com/workspace/. Client Says reads them through a hidden read-only frame (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Android) or, where browsers keep frames apart (Safari, every iOS browser), through "Load your team", a one-tap round trip to that page. Client Says never writes to it. Nothing is sent to a server. The Workspace page explains what it keeps: https://neorgon.com/workspace/ and https://neorgon.com/privacy/.

- Your zone is the starting zone and the "Your zone" line on its card; your time format sets the clock.
- "My team's zones" adds the distinct zones of a team as cards. Zones it cannot show (another IANA zone, an offset) and people with no zone are listed by name, never dropped.
